renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Use ONLY the claims in the ESSENCE list below; every paragraph must correspond to at least one essence item (record indices). Do not add doctrines, comparisons, meta-commentary, or quoted terms. ESSENCE: [0] Partial shining marks inert; measure-evading awareness differs.

paragraphs.text: Here is how you tell a dead thing from awareness: a dead thing only shines a little bit, in patches. Awareness is the opposite — no measuring cup can hold it.
Partial shine means inert. Uncontainable by measure means aware. That is the test.

Partial: dead. Unmeasurable: aware. Mark and difference, done.
